title: 第二十三章 如筑第二十四章 洞真宫
content_zh:
铁蛋从地上爬起来，看看被他贯在剑尖，一剑钉到墙上，死不瞑目的杂修小少爷。又扭头扫了一眼阁楼。
这杂修，手里乱七八糟的玩意还真不少。
阁楼正中，大概是镇压阵眼的位置，放着个三足青铜大鼎。瞧着纹路图形与仙宫画风有些出入，大致是什么上古神物。这会儿大鼎依然在自发运转，把这史家大院中，熬炼家奴血肉调集的灵炁，抽水泵似的，源源不绝运送到这房中来。
而大鼎里血气冲天，铁蛋瞧了瞧，看看周围横七竖八，倒了好几个丫鬟女婢，都是早被弄死了，凉透了，应当是被放光了血，和着什么朱砂草籽的，做成一锅染料，用来画符写咒，布置阵法的耗材。
而除了房中大鼎，屋顶的宝珠，瓦上金龙，周围还有些零零碎碎，乱七八遭的剑戟刀枪，玉锤石牌的，俱是精致的名品，宝粼粼，看来也都是可以用来斗战的法宝。周围也有好几叠符纸金箭，都还没来得及使用呢。
你还真别说，还真幸亏是果断冲上来突脸，趁着措手不及，一剑把这杂修给刺死了。
若真和这家伙摆开阵势斗法，对方有阵法聚灵，宝珠护体，手里又有五花八门的诸般宝贝，破一件再换一件，这得打到什么时候去，等援兵到了，恐怕还真是胜负未可知呢。
“怎么样，没事吧，没事就挑一件走。”
岳鹏进来，只扫了一眼，就抱着剑站在那儿，以真炁养剑，竟分毫不取。
“一件？师兄不拿么？”
岳鹏摇头，
“我此番出手，是帮你渡劫，给你助剑，不是来结仇的。”
铁蛋看看被钉在墙上，死不瞑目的杂修，又瞧瞧院外，已把大半史府点燃的火海，一时竟然无语。
都把人家杀成这样，还不算结仇？
岳鹏挠挠头，还真解释不清，
“我玄门中人，铲灭魔宫，本来就是天经地义，这杂修本不在劫里，他挡我去路，虽是自取死道，但到底这修行中人，多半有师门道侣的，打一个能牵出一大片。不过只要不取他东西，应当不算在因果中……
唉，总之以后你自己问师父吧。反正记得，这次你是来渡劫的，突破用的大宝只捡一件，若多拿了，人家便有由头，找上门来讨债了。”
虽然不知道你在说什么，总之只能捡一件么……
看看满屋的破烂，铁蛋一时也有些犹豫。
屋顶那条金龙倒是好大一坨金精，只可惜被杂修炼杂了，又被师兄一剑灌爆，上好的金精，遭了赤煞，紫霞之炁浸染，大概要找丹师熬炼好久才能用。而其他的东西，不仅属性不对，似乎也是些垃圾，而且也不知道是不是有器灵……

“对了铁蛋，你之前可是得了什么机缘么？”
正在铁蛋犹豫之时，岳鹏盯着他已经被血息治愈的左臂，皱起眉头，
“刚才你的身法剑力，瞧着好像已有筑基的功底了啊……”
铁蛋也不知该怎么解释。
说到底，他之前的奇遇，以及现在的状态，确实是前所未有的，自己也不知道自己算是个什么状态。
毕竟，若按照《铸剑诀》的正常流程，炼炁期圆满之后，是取一天材地宝，最好是金精铁种这样，蕴含醇正神罡真炁的筑基大宝，请丹师炼化为假丹，吞服口腹之中，贮藏于丹田之内，日夜苦修，炼化突破，最终借此神罡之炁灌顶，洗炼全身，打通奇经八脉，才得超凡脱俗，脱胎换骨，筑基成功。
这个步骤说来简单，其实一点也不容易。毕竟万丈高楼平地起，基底打得牢不牢靠，根骨洗炼扎不扎实，是直接影响道身修行的上限的。
而且大道三千，玄门各派的秘传不尽相同，那些上乘功法的关键，都是从炼炁筑基就开始打下了。因此师门长辈对入门弟子筑基突破，都极为慎重。很多秘传关窍，都是最后关头才耳提面命，口口相传的。
所以铁蛋确实还没以《铸剑诀》筑基呢。
但问题是，他已经变强了。
比起之前凡人身体，那肯定是超凡脱俗了。
content_en:
Tiedan got up from the ground and looked at the young miscellaneous cultivator who was impaled on the wall by his sword. He turned and glanced at the attic again.
This miscellaneous cultivator has quite a lot of messy stuff in his hands.
In the middle of the attic, probably where the suppression formation was, there was a three-legged bronze cauldron. Looking at the patterns and patterns, they are somewhat different from the fairy palace painting style. It is probably some kind of ancient divine object. At this moment, the big cauldron was still operating spontaneously, continuously transporting the spiritual energy collected from the flesh and blood of the slaves in the courtyard of the historian's family, like a water pump, to this room.
The cauldron was full of blood. Tiedan looked around and saw that there were several maids and maidservants lying around. They had all been killed long ago. They were so cold that they should have drained all their blood. They mixed it with some cinnabar and grass seeds to make a pot of dye, which was used to draw talismans, write spells, and arrange consumables for formations.
In addition to the big cauldron in the room, the orbs on the roof, and the golden dragon on the tiles, there are also some scattered pieces around, including swords, halberds, knives, and jade hammers. There are also several stacks of paper talismans and golden arrows around, but they haven't had a chance to be used yet.
Don't tell me, it's really lucky that you rushed forward decisively, caught him off guard, and stabbed the miscellaneous cultivator to death with a sword.
If we really engage in a battle with this guy, the opponent has a formation to gather spirits, orbs to protect the body, and he has all kinds of treasures in his hand. If you break one piece and replace it with another, how long will it take to fight? When reinforcements arrive, the outcome may be uncertain.
"How about it? It's okay. Just pick something and go."
Yue Peng came in, glanced at it, and stood there with his sword in his arms, using his true strength to nourish the sword without taking any of it away.
"One piece? Senior brother, won't you take it?"
Yue Peng shook his head,
"I am taking action this time to help you overcome the calamity and to give you a sword, not to make enemies."
Tiedan looked at the miscellaneous cultivators who were nailed to the wall with their eyes open, and then looked at the sea of fire outside the courtyard that had set most of the Shi's residence on fire. He was speechless for a moment.
If you kill people like this, doesn't that count as a feud?
Yue Peng scratched his head and couldn't explain it clearly.
"It is natural for me, a member of Xuanmen, to eradicate the Demonic Palace. This miscellaneous cultivator is not in the calamity at all. He blocked my way. Although he is seeking his own death, after all, most of these cultivators have Taoist disciples. One of them can lead to a large area. But as long as you don't take his things, it should not be counted in the cause and effect...
Alas, you can ask Master yourself in the future. Anyway, remember, you are here to overcome the tribulation this time, and you only picked up one big treasure for breakthrough. If you take more, people will have a reason to come to collect debts. "
I don’t know what you are talking about, but I can only pick up one piece...
Looking at the rags all over the house, Tiedan hesitated for a moment.
The golden dragon on the roof is quite a big lump of gold essence. Unfortunately, it has been mixed up by various practices and exploded with a sword from the senior brother. The fine gold essence has been imbued with the energy of Red Evil and Purple Clouds. It will probably take a long time to be refined by an alchemist before it can be used. As for other things, not only do they have wrong attributes, but they also seem to be junk, and I don’t know if they have weapon spirits...
"By the way Tiedan, have you had any opportunities before?"
While Tiedan was hesitating, Yue Peng stared at his left arm that had been healed by blood and frowned.
"Just now, your movement and sword power looked like you already had foundation building skills..."
Tiedan didn’t know how to explain it.
After all, his previous adventures and current state were indeed unprecedented, and he didn't know what state he was in.
After all, if we follow the normal process of "Forging Sword", after the Qi refining period is complete, we need to take a material treasure, preferably gold and iron, a foundation-building treasure that contains the true Qi of the righteous God, and ask the alchemist to refine it into a fake Dan, swallow it in the mouth and stomach, store it in the Dantian, practice hard day and night, refine and make breakthroughs, and finally use the power of the divine power to empower the whole body, cleanse the whole body, open up the eight extraordinary meridians, and then be transcendent, reborn, and build the foundation.success.
This step sounds simple, but in fact it is not easy at all. After all, if a tall building rises from the ground, whether the foundation is solid or not, and whether the bones are refining and solid, will directly affect the upper limit of Taoist cultivation.
Moreover, in the Three Thousand Dao, the secrets of each Taoist sect are different, and the keys to those superior techniques are all laid down from the time of Qi Refining and Foundation Building. Therefore, the elders of the master's sect are extremely cautious about the entry-level disciples' foundation-building breakthroughs. Many secret secrets are only mentioned at the last moment and passed down from word of mouth.
So Tiedan really hasn't built a foundation with "Sword Forging Technique" yet.
But the problem is, he has become stronger.
Compared to the previous mortal body, it was definitely otherworldly.
